Your task is to determine the actual landing times for all six aircraft such that each aircraft lands within its allowed time window, the separation requirements between consecutive landings are satisfied, and the total penalty cost, which is the sum of the penalties for landing early or late for all aircraft, is minimized. import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "aircraft": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "target":   {0: 86, 1: 60, 2: 71, 3: 97, 4: 89, 5: 74},
    "earliest": {0: 60, 1: 60, 2: 60, 3: 67, 4: 60, 5: 60},
    "latest":   {0: 100, 1: 90, 2: 100, 3: 100, 4: 100, 5: 100},
    "early_cost": {0: 12, 1: 13, 2: 16, 3: 14, 4: 15, 5: 14},
    "late_cost":  {0: 20, 1: 16, 2: 15, 3: 13, 4: 18, 5: 19},
    # separation[i][j] = min time between i and j when i lands before j
    "separation": {
        0: {1: 7, 2: 7, 3: 5, 4: 5, 5: 5},
        1: {0: 5, 2: 7, 3: 5, 4: 8, 5: 7},
        2: {0: 5, 1: 8, 3: 8, 4: 8, 5: 6},
        3: {0: 8, 1: 8, 2: 8, 4: 6, 5: 5},
        4: {0: 7, 1: 7, 2: 6, 3: 8, 5: 6},
        5: {0: 7, 1: 5, 2: 8, 3: 7, 4: 7},
    },
    "big_M": 200,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    A = d["aircraft"]
    pairs = [(i, j) for i in A for j in A if i < j]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()
    model.A = pyo.Set(initialize=A)
    model.Pairs = pyo.Set(initialize=pairs, dimen=2)

    model.land = pyo.Var(
        model.A,
        within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=lambda m, i: (d["earliest"][i], d["latest"][i]),
    )
    model.early = pyo.Var(model.A, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.late = pyo.Var(model.A, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.before = pyo.Var(model.Pairs, within=pyo.Binary)

    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(
            d["early_cost"][i] * m.early[i] + d["late_cost"][i] * m.late[i]
            for i in A
        )

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    def deficit_rule(m, i):
        return m.land[i] - d["target"][i] == m.late[i] - m.early[i]

    model.deficit = pyo.Constraint(model.A, rule=deficit_rule)

    def sep_ij_rule(m, i, j):
        # if i before j: land[j] >= land[i] + sep[i][j]
        return m.land[j] >= (
            m.land[i]
            + d["separation"][i][j]
            - d["big_M"] * (1 - m.before[i, j])
        )

    model.sep_ij = pyo.Constraint(model.Pairs, rule=sep_ij_rule)

    def sep_ji_rule(m, i, j):
        # if j before i: land[i] >= land[j] + sep[j][i]
        return m.land[i] >= (
            m.land[j]
            + d["separation"][j][i]
            - d["big_M"] * m.before[i, j]
        )

    model.sep_ji = pyo.Constraint(model.Pairs, rule=sep_ji_rule)

    return model

    "early_cost": {0: 12, 1: 13, 2: 16, 3: 14, 4: 15, 5: 14},

    # Late penalty per unit time ("... and ... units per time unit for landing late")

    # Big-M: larger than any possible time difference plus separation

def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    I = d["aircraft"]

    # unordered ordered pairs i < j
    pairs = [(i, j) for i in I for j in I if i < j]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.I = pyo.Set(initialize=I)
    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=pairs, dimen=2)

    # Landing time
    def t_bounds(m, i):
        return (d["earliest"][i], d["latest"][i])

    model.t = pyo.Var(model.I, domain=pyo.Reals, bounds=t_bounds)

    # Earliness / lateness
    model.early = pyo.Var(model.I, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.late = pyo.Var(model.I, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Ordering binary: y[i,j] = 1 if i lands before j
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.P, domain=pyo.Binary)

    # Objective: minimize total weighted penalty
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["early_cost"][i] * m.early[i] + d["late_cost"][i] * m.late[i]
                   for i in m.I)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Link landing time to target +/- earliness/lateness
    def time_link_rule(m, i):
        return m.t[i] == d["target"][i] - m.early[i] + m.late[i]

    model.time_link = pyo.Constraint(model.I, rule=time_link_rule)

    # Disjunctive separation constraints for each pair (i,j), i<j
    def sep_ij_rule(m, i, j):
        # If i before j (y=1): t_j >= t_i + sep[i][j]
        return m.t[j] >= m.t[i] + d["sep"][i][j] - d["bigM"] * (1 - m.y[i, j])

    def sep_ji_rule(m, i, j):
        # If j before i (y=0): t_i >= t_j + sep[j][i]
        return m.t[i] >= m.t[j] + d["sep"][j][i] - d["bigM"] * m.y[i, j]

    model.sep_ij = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=sep_ij_rule)
    model.sep_ji = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=sep_ji_rule)

    return model

def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.I = pyo.Set(initialize=d["aircraft"])
    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["pairs"], dimen=2)

    model.t = pyo.Var(
        model.I,
        within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=lambda m, i: (d["earliest"][i], d["latest"][i]),
    )
    model.e = pyo.Var(model.I, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.l = pyo.Var(model.I, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.P, within=pyo.Binary)

    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["early_cost"][i] * m.e[i] + d["late_cost"][i] * m.l[i]
                   for i in m.I)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # t[i] = target[i] + l[i] - e[i]
    def time_rule(m, i):
        return m.t[i] == d["target"][i] + m.l[i] - m.e[i]

    model.c_time = pyo.Constraint(model.I, rule=time_rule)

    # Disjunctive separation for each unordered pair (i<j):
    # y[i,j]=1 => i before j:  t[j] >= t[i] + sep[i][j]
    # y[i,j]=0 => j before i:  t[i] >= t[j] + sep[j][i]
    def sep_rule_ij(m, i, j):
        M = d["bigM"]
        s_ij = d["sep"][i][j]
        return m.t[j] - m.t[i] >= s_ij - M * (1 - m.y[i, j])

    def sep_rule_ji(m, i, j):
        M = d["bigM"]
        s_ji = d["sep"][j][i]
        return m.t[i] - m.t[j] >= s_ji - M * m.y[i, j]

    model.c_sep_ij = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=sep_rule_ij)
    model.c_sep_ji = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=sep_rule_ji)

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "aircraft": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "E":  {0: 60, 1: 60, 2: 60, 3: 67, 4: 60, 5: 60},   # earliest allowed
    "L":  {0: 100, 1: 90, 2: 100, 3: 100, 4: 100, 5: 100},  # latest allowed
    "T":  {0: 86, 1: 60, 2: 71, 3: 97, 4: 89, 5: 74},        # target
    "cE": {0: 12, 1: 13, 2: 16, 3: 14, 4: 15, 5: 14},        # early penalty
    "cL": {0: 20, 1: 16, 2: 15, 3: 13, 4: 18, 5: 19},        # late penalty
    # sep[(i,j)] means "If i lands BEFORE j, minimum separation"
    "sep": {
        0: {1: 7, 2: 7, 3: 5, 4: 5, 5: 5},
        1: {0: 5, 2: 7, 3: 5, 4: 8, 5: 7},
        2: {1: 8, 0: 5, 3: 8, 4: 8, 5: 6},
        3: {0: 8, 1: 8, 2: 8, 4: 6, 5: 5},
        4: {0: 7, 1: 7, 2: 6, 3: 8, 5: 6},
        5: {0: 7, 1: 5, 2: 8, 3: 7, 4: 7}
    },
    "BIG_M": 1000,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    A = d["aircraft"]
    E, L = d["E"], d["L"]
    T, cE, cL = d["T"], d["cE"], d["cL"]
    sep = d["sep"]
    BIG_M = d["BIG_M"]

    pair_list = [(i, j) for i in A for j in A if i < j]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()
    model.A = pyo.Set(initialize=A)
    model.Pairs = pyo.Set(initialize=pair_list, dimen=2)

    # x[i] = actual landing time within [E_i, L_i]
    def x_bounds(m, i):
        return (E[i], L[i])
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.A, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=x_bounds)

    # earliness and lateness variables
    model.e = pyo.Var(model.A, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.l = pyo.Var(model.A, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # z[i,j] = 1 if i precedes j, else 0 (j precedes i)
    model.z = pyo.Var(model.Pairs, within=pyo.Binary)

    # ---- Objective: minimize total weighted earliness/lateness ----
    def rule_obj(m):
        return sum(cE[i] * m.e[i] + cL[i] * m.l[i] for i in m.A)
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=rule_obj, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # ---- Earliness/lateness definition:l_i - e_i = x_i - T_i ----
    def rule_al_link(m, i):
        return m.l[i] - m.e[i] == m.x[i] - T[i]
    model.e_l_link = pyo.Constraint(model.A, rule=rule_al_link)

    # ---- Disjunctive separation constraints ----
    # If z[i,j] = 1 :  x[j] >= x[i] + sep[i][j]   =>  x[j] - x[i] >= sep[i][j]
    # If z[i,j] = 0 :  x[i] >= x[j] + sep[j][i]
    def rule_sep_ij(m, i, j):
        s_ij = sep[i][j]
        return m.x[j] - m.x[i] >= s_ij - BIG_M * (1 - m.z[i, j])
    model.sep_ij = pyo.Constraint(model.Pairs, rule=rule_sep_ij)

    def rule_sep_ji(m, i, j):
        s_ji = sep[j][i]
        return m.x[i] - m.x[j] >= s_ji - BIG_M * (m.z[i, j])
    model.sep_ji = pyo.Constraint(model.Pairs, rule=rule_sep_ji)

    return model
